text:
Elena M: I’m opening a quick warroom — multiple support tickets and telemetry showing elevated 5xx and timeout rates for hosted inference (EU region) on /v1/generate. Started ~09:10 UTC, error spike to ~22% of requests. Investigating.
IncidentBot: Warroom created: https://redwood-internal/warroom/2123456789 — responders: @Vikram S (oncall), @Josh R (runtime), @Samir K (infra).
Vikram S: Ack. I’m on it. First pass: is this after any deploy?
Josh R: Yes, there was a small gateway routing change rolled at 09:05 that modifies upstream health-check window and circuit breaker thresholds. Rolling back now if needed.
Samir K: Looking at infra graphs — autoscaler is flapping for the gpu-serving pool in eu-west-1 around 09:08-09:12. Pod restart count jumped; several pods show OOMKilled in kube events.
Priya N: Customers reporting 502/504s and higher latencies (examples attached in tickets). A few say they saw repeated failures during batch inference jobs. Ticket IDs: #C-10112, #C-10119, #C-10121.
Elena M: Repro attempt: cURL shows 504 with header X-Request-ID present. Example request: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","input":"hi"}' -v` -> TLS ok, upstream times out at ~30s.
Josh R: Putting up a temporary config: increase gateway timeout to 60s and relax circuit breaker for rwd-4b traffic. Command I’m running now: ```kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n hosted --type merge -p '{"data":{"upstream_timeout":"60s","cb_error_threshold":"0.6"}}'```
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: gateway-config patch applied by Josh R (rollout id roll-9876).
Samir K: Scaling up gpu-serving pool by +4 nodes to absorb backlog. Also found a regression in our memory limiter causing larger batches to allocate more than expected — preventing some pods from serving. Rolling a hotfix to revert batching optimizer.
Vikram S: Routing note: routing policy is set to prefer eu-west capacity. I’m switching a subset (10%) of traffic to fallback model rwd-1b in us-east to relieve pressure — enabling model variant fallback in routing policy.
Priya N: Noted customers impacted by region: most EU tenants; will send a status update to affected customers once we have mitigation stable.
Elena M: After rollback and scaling, error rate dropped to ~3% at 09:42 UTC. Some residual 502s from older requests still in queues. Monitoring for 30m.
Josh R: Root cause hypothesis: gateway routing change decreased circuit breaker headroom + batching optimizer regression = memory pressure -> pods OOM -> upstream 502/504 when requests hit unavailable backends.
Samir K: Evidence: kube events + pod logs show `oom_kill` for process `inference-worker` and stack traces referencing batch allocation. Also saw increased GC pauses in JVM-based aggregator at same time.
Vikram S: Action items (assigning now):
- rollback-gateway-config: Josh R (done)
- revert-batching-optimizer: Samir K (in progress, PR 4321)
- scale-gpu-pool-temporarily: Samir K (done)
- open customer communications: Priya N (drafted)
- postmortem doc + timeline: Elena M (you)
Elena M: Creating postmortem doc and linking to warroom notes. Will include timeline, root cause, impact, and mitigation plan.
Priya N: Customer update posted at 09:55 UTC: "We're experiencing degraded inference availability in EU due to traffic surge and a configuration regression. Mitigation in progress; fallback routing enabled."
Vikram S: Follow-up checks: increase canary validation window, add synthetic probes for model-serving memory use, and add unit test for batching optimizer to prevent regression.
Josh R: Quick repro steps for infra team:
1) Apply gateway config with reduced cb_error_threshold `0.3` and upstream_timeout `25s`.
2) Trigger synthetic batched requests approximating 12 concurrent long-context sessions.
3) Observe pod memory growth and OOM after ~5–10 minutes.
(Logs captured: `inference-worker: alloc 2.4GB -> 8.1GB in 6s`.)
Samir K: Post-incident mitigation implemented:
- Revert batching optimizer (hotfix roll-9878) -> rolled at 09:30 UTC.
- Temporarily bumped node pool size + retry budget on gateway -> done.
- Enabled model fallback to rwd-1b for 10% EU traffic while autoscaling stabilizes.
Elena M: Postmortem draft link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/2123456789 — please add notes and assign owners for each action item.
Priya N: SLA impact summary for support: ~15 customers experienced >5 minutes elevated errors, 3 customers reported job failures. Preparing compensation recommendations.
Vikram S: Long-term action items:
- Add memory headroom checks in CI for batching changes (owner: Josh R)
- Harden autoscaler thresholds to avoid flapping under sudden GC pauses (owner: Samir K)
- Add per-model circuit-breaker tuning automated by canary signals (owner: Elena M)
- Improve customer-facing retries guidance and SDK backoff defaults (owner: Priya N)
Josh R: I’ll open the PRs this afternoon for CI tests and the canary tuning playbook.
Samir K: Will schedule an infra review to audit node types and GC tuning in EU pools.
Elena M: Closing warroom — moving thread to postmortem and tracking action items in the postmortem doc. If anything regresses reopen. Thanks everyone for the quick responses :raised_hands:
